subject.title: fix(agents): load bootstrap files from agentDir alongside workspace

question: Should explicitly configured `agentDir` become a higher-precedence bootstrap instruction source, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only authority and warn users about misplaced files?
rationale: Current code and docs deliberately separate workspace persona and instruction files from agent runtime state, while the issue leaves both behaviors open; choosing a new precedence and trust boundary requires maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve workspace authority
options.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only and add an actionable startup or Doctor warning for bootstrap-named files under `agentDir`.

options.title: Approve agentDir overrides
options.body: Intentionally redefine explicit `agentDir` as a higher-precedence instruction source, then document and test fresh-install, upgrade, cache, hook, and security behavior.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace authority
recommendation.body: Keep bootstrap loading workspace-only and add an actionable startup or Doctor warning for bootstrap-named files under `agentDir`.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest history signal spans bootstrap safety, workspace boundaries, multi-agent state, and the corresponding documentation contract.
